title: subject URA can differ in namespace/scope/type from callee URA
description: Under RFC 001, a callee agent can act on a subject that lives in a different namespace. A receipt records both URAs independently. This test pins that the runtime MUST accept a subject whose namespace/scope/subject-type differs from the callee.
